from pathlib import Path
import struct

def seg(num, typ, page, body, refs=[]):
    b=struct.pack('>I',num)+bytes([typ])
    n=len(refs)
    assert n<7 and num<=256
    b+=bytes([n<<5])
    for r in refs: b+=bytes([r])
    b+=bytes([page])
    b+=struct.pack('>I',len(body))
    return b+body

out=bytearray(bytes([0x97,0x4a,0x42,0x32,0x0d,0x0a,0x1a,0x0a,0x03]))
# page info 10x10
page=struct.pack('>IIII',10,10,0,0)+bytes([0])+struct.pack('>H',0)
out+=seg(1,48,1,page)
# pattern dict, 3 patterns of 1x1, MMR; body one zero byte
pd=bytes([1,1,1])+struct.pack('>I',2)+b'\x00'
out+=seg(2,16,0,pd)
# halftone region 1x1, HMMR, grid 1x1, vectors 0, payload placeholder
payload=bytes([0x80])  # V0 bit then zeros
hr=struct.pack('>IIII',1,1,0,0)+bytes([0])+bytes([1])+struct.pack('>IIii',1,1,0,0)+struct.pack('>HH',0,0)+payload
out+=seg(3,22,1,hr,refs=[2])
out+=seg(4,49,1,b'')
out+=seg(5,51,0,b'')
Path('/workspace/cand1.jb2').write_bytes(out)
print(len(out), out.hex())
